meta_description:
nidhisunil on March 17, 2026: "The dawn is breaking after the eternal night;
I am grateful for the breaking light:
But i am grateful even more for the eternal night. 

1st slide Yoshida Tōshi, Sunrise, 1989
last slide Chiura Obata, Setting Sun on Sacremento Valley, California, 1930".
